correctness.rationale: Every finite Boolean homomorphism is uniquely inverse image of a set function. Exact threshold preservation over all subsets excludes zero-size fibers and reduces to the highest loser sum and lowest winner sum. Pairwise averaging of nonuniform integer fibers simultaneously relaxes both inequalities, yielding the displayed closed feasibility interval. Multinomial counting with multiplicity correction gives the exact hom-set size. For n=m all maps are permutations; strict partial sums of any nonconstant profile prove endpoint rigidity, while one q−1 and one q+1 give interior nonuniform maps exactly when q≥3. Complement conjugation gives the dual-quota symmetry. A separately coded all-subset semantics brute checker verified 82,200 labeled functions, 441 parameter families, and a 9-to-3 19,683-table example. General proof is independent of those finite tests.
